```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)

Water_data <- read.delim('/home/mad149/chapter_meta_analysis/metadata/Studies_salinity_metadata_All - Studies_salinity_metadata_water.csv(2).tsv', sep='\t', stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
Water_data$Salinity<- as.numeric(gsub( ',','.', Water_data$Salinity))
Water_data$pH<- as.numeric(gsub( ',','.',Water_data$pH))
xblast_half <- read.delim('/home/mad149/chapter_meta_analysis/xblast_output_may20_641_out_of_1116.tsv', sep='\t', stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
merged_df_Water <- merge(Water_data, xblast_half, by = "SRA_id")
```

```{r}
merged_df_Water$Saltern <- NA
merged_df_Water$Saltern[merged_df_Water$Description == 'Saltern'] <- 'Saltern'
merged_df_Water$Saltern[merged_df_Water$Description == 'Sea'] <- 'Sea'
merged_df_Water$Saltern[merged_df_Water$Description == 'River'] <- 'River'
merged_df_Water$Saltern[merged_df_Water$Description == 'Lake'] <- 'Lake'
merged_df_Water$Saltern[merged_df_Water$Description == 'Estuary'] <- 'Estuary'
merged_df_Water$Saltern[merged_df_Water$Description == 'Salt lake'] <- 'Salt lake'
merged_df_Water$Saltern[merged_df_Water$Description == 'Soda Lake'] <- 'Soda Lake'
merged_df_Water$Saltern[merged_df_Water$Description == 'Acidic brine'] <- 'Acidic brine'

ggplot(merged_df_Water, aes(x = Description, y = DEIK_ratio, color=Description)) + geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + ggtitle('Water types DE/IK ratio') + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90)) + geom_jitter() 

ggplot(merged_df_Water, aes(x = Description, y = pH, color=Description)) + geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + ggtitle('Water types pH') + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90)) + geom_jitter() 
ggplot(merged_df_Water, aes(x = Description, y = log(Salinity), color=Description)) + geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + ggtitle('Water types salinity') + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90)) + geom_jitter() 

ggplot(merged_df_Water, aes(x = log(Salinity), y = DEIK_ratio)) + geom_point(aes(col=merged_df_Water$Saltern)) + ggtitle('Water types DE/IK ratio')

ggplot(merged_df_Water, aes(x = log(Salinity), y = DEIK_ratio)) + geom_point(alpha=0.7) + ggtitle('Water types DE/IK ratio') + geom_smooth()

ggplot(merged_df_Water, aes(x = pH, y = DEIK_ratio, color=Saltern)) + geom_point() + ggtitle('Water types DE/IK ratio')
Water_DEIK <- lm(data=merged_df_Water, DEIK_ratio~Salinity)
summary(Water_DEIK)

ggplot(merged_df_Water, aes(x = pH, y =DEIK_ratio)) + geom_point() + geom_smooth()+ ggtitle('Water types DE/IK ratio')

```


```{r}
library(data.table)
long <- melt(setDT(merged_df_Water[,c(6, 20:61)]), id.vars = c("Salinity"), variable.name = "Protein_id")
long <- na.omit(long)
```


```{r}
Exporters <- c( 'total_CPA_count','CorA_count', 'NhaB_count', 'NhaC_count', 'NhaD_count',  'Na_Ca_count','Hppase_count', 'MtrA_count', 'NqrA_count', 'MgtE_count','ClcA_count', 'TrkH_count','MnhE_count')

long_ex<- long[long$Protein_id %in% Exporters]
```

```{r}
library(corrplot)
corrplot(cor(merged_df_Water[,-c(1:19, 62)]), method = "square")
clean_df_water_sal  <- merged_df_Water %>% drop_na(Salinity)
corrplot(cor(clean_df_water_sal[clean_df_water_sal$Description == 'Soda Lake',][,-c(1:5, 7:19, 62)]), method = "square")
corrplot(cor(clean_df_water_sal[clean_df_water_sal$Description == 'Saltern',][,-c(1:5, 7:19, 62)]), method = "square")
corrplot(cor(clean_df_water_sal[clean_df_water_sal$Description == 'Salt lake',][,-c(1:5, 7:19, 62)]), method = "square")

corrplot(cor(clean_df_water_sal[clean_df_water_sal$Description != 'Soda Lake',][,-c(1:5, 7:19, 62)]), method = "square")


clean_df_water_pH  <- merged_df_Water %>% drop_na(pH)
corrplot(cor(clean_df_water_pH[,-c(1:4, 6:19, 62)]), method = "square")
```

```{r}
library(factoextra)
#install.packages('ggfortify')
library(ggfortify)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
grote_spelers <- c('Sea', 'River', 'Estuary', 'Deepsea', 'Lake', 'Saltern', 'Salt lake', 'Groundwater', 'AMD', 'Soda Lake', 'Acidic brine')

merged_df_Water_big<- merged_df_Water[merged_df_Water$Description %in% grote_spelers,]


pca_values <- prcomp(merged_df_Water_big[,-c(1:19, 62)], center = TRUE, scale.=TRUE)

autoplot(pca_values, loadings = TRUE, loadings.label = TRUE, data = merged_df_Water_big, colour='Description')

pca_points <- 
  as_tibble(pca_values$x) %>% 
  bind_cols(merged_df_Water_big)

head(pca_points)

basic_plot <- 
  ggplot(pca_points, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = Description)) +
  theme_light()

basic_plot

pca_hull <- 
  pca_points %>% 
  group_by(Description) %>% 
  slice(chull(PC1, PC2))

# now, we'll just continue to build on our ggplot object
chull_plot <- 
  basic_plot +
  geom_polygon(data = pca_hull,
               aes(fill = Description,
                   colour = Description),
               alpha = 0.3,
               show.legend = FALSE)

chull_plot
```
